text: 周四（10月29日）欧市尾盘，英国10年期国债收益率跌2.7个基点，报5.294%，整体大致呈现出W形走势，北京时间19:39前后微幅转涨，21:35跌至5.249%刷新日低。 两年期英债收益率跌4.7个基点，报4.897%，全天处于下跌状态，整体震荡下行、21:35跌至4.855%刷新日低。 30年期英债收益率跌0.5个基点，50年期英债收益率跌0.1个基点。 2/10年期英债收益率利差涨1.937个基点，报+39.507个基点。
text_en: Thursday (Oct 29) late European session: UK 10-year gilt yield fell 2.7 bps to 5.294%, broadly tracing a W-shaped path, turning slightly positive around 19:39 Beijing time and falling to 5.249% at 21:35 to refresh the day's low. The 2-year gilt yield fell 4.7 bps to 4.897%, falling throughout the day, oscillating lower and hitting 4.855% at 21:35 to refresh the day's low. The 30-year gilt yield fell 0.5 bps, and the 50-year gilt yield fell 0.1 bps. The 2/10-year gilt yield spread widened 1.937 bps to +39.507 bps.
